reader.requirement: At --std 85, with CODE literal-1 the two code characters precede each report record, column numbers count from the first position after them (they are not part of the print line), and the logical record size includes them (record = code + line), whichever RECORD clause form (fixed, VARYING, none) the report file has.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002 picks the 1985 citation in the record-shorter-than-code message (COBOL7441) only; LineWidth = record - code length is common
the two-character length rule (SR1) at 85; not GR2

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the code-plus-line record is built the same way at every edition; the runtime's _code + line.Compose() has no edition test
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers a record exactly the code's size; a line after the code, a VARYING record and a file with no RECORD clause are not exercised

probes.expected: RECORD CONTAINS 10, CODE "AB", COLUMN 1 XYZ, COLUMN 6 123: AB then the 8-position line, XYZ at line column 1, 123 at line column 6
RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 5 TO 12: the line is 10 positions after the code
no RECORD clause: the code still precedes the line and columns count after it
RECORD CONTAINS 8: the record of 8 includes the code, so the line has 6 positions (the column beyond is cut, the documented Annex latitude)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.6.4 GR2  (3.6.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: ResolveReports sets LineWidth = record size - code length and the runtime writes code + composed line, so the code occupies record positions and no line positions. Trailing spaces of a print record are dropped by the line-sequential report device, an implementor matter.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85: cd1 one report file, RECORD CONTAINS 12, two reports R-1 CODE "AA" (with PAGE and a page heading) and R-2 CODE "BB"; od -c of CD1.RPT: AAHEAD / (blank) / AAONE    END / BB0123456789 / AAONE    END. R-2's PIC X(10) at COLUMN 1 fills the 10-position line exactly after the 2-character code, so the code is in the 12-position record and not in the line, as GR2 says; each report carries its own code. cd3 (COLUMN 2 PIC X(10), one past the 10-position line) compiles and prints BB 012345678, the item cut at the record end. No 1985 rule refuses a print line longer than the record: §1985:XIII.3.2.4 GR2 leaves the report writer logical record structure to the implementor, so this is latitude and not a GR2 breach. The blank line between the heading and the first detail is an empty device line with no code: that is GR1 and device positioning, not GR2. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.6.4 GR2 [are included in the logical record size]; OK §1985:XIII.3.2.4 GR2 [is defined by the implementor].
